query: Put the Checkout feature behind a feature flag.
setup: docs/feature-map.md exists and lists Checkout under Orders with kind http-route, entrypoint apps/api/src/routes/checkout.ts:18, confidence EXTRACTED
@openfeature/server-sdk is installed and a provider is configured in apps/api/src/shared/config/openfeature.ts
expected_behavior: Reads docs/feature-map.md and confirms Checkout with the user from the map instead of asking them to describe it
Detects the existing OpenFeature setup and reuses it; does not propose a second flag library or an env-var mechanism
Chooses the entrypoint as gate boundary (route registration or a guard at the top of the handler returning 404) and states why over an internal branch
Defines the flag contract: key prefixed by the capability (orders.checkout), boolean, default true so merging changes nothing, owner, expected lifetime, review date
Produces an ordered task list with one single read site for the flag, on/off tests tagged [unit], a task updating the Flags section of the feature map, and a [UAT] task verifying the off state
Saves the plan to .cor/ per Plan Storage and writes no application code
